newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nova shares fall on OTC market.
newsitem.headline: Nova shares fall on OTC market.

text.p: Shares in Nova Corp, which runs English conversation shools, fell sharply on Thursday, hitting their lowest level since they were registered on the over-the-counter (OTC) market late last year.
As of 0438 GMT, the share price was down 350 yen at 3,550 yen, after it briefly dipped to a low of 3,450 yen. Volume was 35,000 shares.

Some sales were prompted by an article in a Japanese weekly magazine published on Thursday referring to problems between the school and students, brokers said. The article fanned concerns about the company's future profits, they said.
Nova officials were not immediately available for comment on the article.
